changeSet.author: codex
changeSet.comment: Fresh-install synchronization layout. Existing checkpoints and route state are not converted or erased.
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE google_health.data_point ALTER COLUMN last_seen_run DROP NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE google_health.heart_rate_sample ALTER COLUMN last_seen_run DROP NOT NULL; ALTER TABLE google_health.heart_rate_sample ADD COLUMN identity_key char(64), ADD COLUMN google_resource_name text, ADD COLUMN raw_json jsonb, ADD COLUMN updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(); ALTER TABLE google_health.heart_rate_sample DROP CONSTRAINT uq_google_health_heart_rate_sample; CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_google_health_heart_rate_identity ON google_health.heart_rate_sample(connection_id,identity_key); CREATE TABLE google_health.sync_control ( account_id text PRIMARY KEY, generation bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, recent_rotation integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, history_rotation integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, cooldown_until timestamptz, updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE TABLE google_health.recent_pass ( account_id text NOT NULL, data_type text NOT NULL, representation text NOT NULL, calendar_policy text NOT NULL, key_policy text NOT NULL, id uuid NOT NULL, started_at timestamptz NOT NULL, target_start timestamptz NOT NULL, target_end timestamptz NOT NULL, next_end timestamptz NOT NULL, state text NOT NULL, completed_at timestamptz, next_due_at timestamptz, cycles bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, fetched bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, changed bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, deleted bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, skipped bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, handed_over bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, fast_start timestamptz, fast_end timestamptz, fast_completed_at timestamptz, budget_limited boolean NOT NULL DEFAULT false, PRIMARY KEY(account_id,data_type,representation,calendar_policy,key_policy)); CREATE TABLE google_health.history_work ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY, account_id text NOT NULL, data_type text NOT NULL, representation text NOT NULL, calendar_policy text NOT NULL, key_policy text NOT NULL, native_day date NOT NULL, lane text NOT NULL, generation bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, start_bound timestamptz NOT NULL, end_bound timestamptz NOT NULL, state text NOT NULL, attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_retry_at timestamptz, safe_error text, started_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE(account_id,data_type,representation,calendar_policy,key_policy,native_day,lane)); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_google_health_active_owner ON google_health.history_work (account_id,data_type,representation,calendar_policy,key_policy) WHERE state='ACTIVE' AND lane='HISTORY'; CREATE INDEX idx_google_health_due_work ON google_health.history_work (account_id,data_type,representation,calendar_policy,key_policy,lane,state,next_retry_at,native_day DESC); CREATE TABLE google_health.history_child ( id uuid PRIMARY KEY, parent_id uuid NOT NULL REFERENCES google_health.history_work(id) ON DELETE CASCADE, traversal_id uuid NOT NULL, start_bound timestamptz NOT NULL, end_bound timestamptz NOT NULL, state text NOT NULL, page_token text, page_count integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, fetched bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, changed bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, stamped bigint NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, token_hashes text[] NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}', updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE INDEX idx_google_health_child_parent ON google_health.history_child(parent_id,start_bound); CREATE TABLE google_health.history_audit ( id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, account_id text NOT NULL, data_type text NOT NULL, representation text NOT NULL, calendar_policy text NOT NULL, key_policy text NOT NULL, native_day date NOT NULL, start_bound timestamptz NOT NULL, end_bound timestamptz NOT NULL, reason text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'HISTORICAL_FINAL_CHECK', outcome text NOT NULL, work_id uuid NOT NULL, traversal_ids uuid[] NOT NULL, fetched bigint NOT NULL, changed bigint NOT NULL, stamped bigint NOT NULL, deleted bigint NOT NULL, started_at timestamptz NOT NULL, completed_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now()); CREATE UNIQUE INDEX uq_google_health_final_day ON google_health.history_audit (account_id,data_type,representation,calendar_policy,key_policy,native_day DESC) WHERE outcome IN ('DATA','EMPTY'); CREATE TABLE google_health.recent_failure ( account_id text NOT NULL, data_type text NOT NULL, representation text NOT NULL, calendar_policy text NOT NULL, key_policy text NOT NULL, purpose text NOT NULL, cell_start timestamptz NOT NULL, cell_end timestamptz NOT NULL, attempt_start timestamptz NOT NULL, attempt_end timestamptz NOT NULL, attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, next_retry_at timestamptz, state text NOT NULL, safe_error text, PRIMARY KEY(account_id,data_type,representation,calendar_policy,key_policy,purpose,cell_start,cell_end)); CREATE INDEX idx_google_health_recent_retry ON google_health.recent_failure (account_id,data_type,representation,calendar_policy,key_policy,state,next_retry_at); CREATE TABLE google_health.route_ownership ( id bigserial PRIMARY KEY, connection_id smallint NOT NULL DEFAULT 1 REFERENCES google_health.connection(id), account_id text NOT NULL, identity_key char(64) NOT NULL, calendar_policy text NOT NULL, native_day date NOT NULL, present boolean NOT NULL, google_resource_name text, physical_start_time timestamptz, physical_end_time timestamptz, fingerprint char(64) NOT NULL, raw_json jsonb NOT NULL, tcx_relative_path text, route_fingerprint char(64), route_version integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 1, indexed_file_id bigint REFERENCES public.indexed_file(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, gps_track_id bigint REFERENCES public.gps_track(id) ON DELETE SET NULL, route_state text NOT NULL DEFAULT 'PENDING', route_error text, route_attempts integer NOT NULL DEFAULT 0, route_file_modified_at timestamptz, route_file_size bigint, route_next_retry_at timestamptz, updated_at timestamptz NOT NULL DEFAULT now(), UNIQUE(account_id,identity_key)); CREATE INDEX idx_google_health_owner_retry ON google_health.route_ownership(connection_id,route_state,route_next_retry_at,id); CREATE INDEX idx_google_health_owner_track ON google_health.route_ownership(gps_track_id) WHERE gps_track_id IS NOT NULL; CREATE INDEX idx_google_health_point_civil_scope ON google_health.data_point(connection_id,data_type,representation,civil_start_time); CREATE INDEX idx_google_health_point_end_scope ON google_health.data_point(connection_id,data_type,representation,physical_end_time);
